instructions: Prepare every ingredient for sheet pan pork tenderloin and bell peppers and preheat the oven.
Coat the pork tenderloin and supporting ingredients evenly with the recorded seasonings.
Arrange the vegetables and seasoned components so heat can circulate around them.
Cook until the ingredients are browned, tender, and safely cooked where applicable.
Rest the sheet pan pork tenderloin and bell peppers briefly, adjust the seasoning, and divide it into portions.
